nodes.label: Brand Glow Backdrop Asset
nodes.rationale: A soft, heavily-blurred radial gradient blob in a light royal blue (#2563EB-family) on a white background. It functions as a decorative brand halo/backdrop behind the Punto logo, reinforcing the primary accent color while keeping the flat, minimal, low-shadow visual language (AGENTS.md 7.1, 7.4). The diffuse edges and low opacity avoid a hard shadow, matching the product's 'borders over shadows' aesthetic and preserving WCAG-friendly text contrast over the light neutral background.
